name: Loop Reflection Carousel
description: Pinned scroll-driven infinite loop carousel where image cards glide across the screen, scaling and fading in and out, each with a blurred mirrored reflection beneath it.
contents: Loop of image cards with type label and title
Blurred faded reflection under each card
behavior: Section is pinned while scrolling scrubs the card loop, wrapping endlessly in both directions
Cards scale and fade in from the center and travel across, then out
Arrow buttons step the loop by one card spacing
editableByProps: Images, titles and type labels, cycled across the cards
Number of cards, spacing, scroll distance

needsCodeEdit.where: w-56 h-72 classes on the card li and gallery__content ul

needsCodeEdit.change: Change travel distance or card scale curve
needsCodeEdit.where: xPercent and scale fromTo calls in buildLoop
top-8 class on the aria-hidden reflection div in SingleCard

fixed: Pins the gallery and uses page scroll for scrubbing through ScrollTrigger, with a scroll range set by scrollLength
Root is full-width and one viewport tall
Card type labels are picked from types with a fixed stride of 3
